qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Entomology/Agricultural Entomology/ Zoology/ any relevant discipline of life sciences from a recognized university. Experience in insect collection, preservation, and taxonomic identification. Hands-on experience in insect dissection, microscopy, scientific imaging, and molecular techniques (DNA extraction, PCR, DNA barcoding, and sequence analysis). Knowledge of phylogenetic analysis, biodiversity surveys, museum curation, and scientific writing with research publications will be preferred.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per the prevailing norms.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Entomology, Agricultural Entomology, Zoology, or any relevant discipline of life sciences from a recognized university to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. SC/ST candidates can avail 5 years, OBC candidates 3 years, and PwBD candidates 10 years of age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their duly filled application and required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow position will be conducted on 7th September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their complete bio-data, scanned copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs as a single merged PDF file via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Division of Entomology, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi - 110012.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment at ICAR IARI.
